description:
§15.10.1 (S458 fourth round, F9) — a prop referenced in `lift
  • …
    • ` markup inside a component's logic block is substituted: bare, inside `if`, inside `for` (text and attribute `${…}`), and a loop binder named like the prop (`for (label of …)`) shadows it in the lifted markup. Before the fix the `lift-expr` walker returned markup targets unchanged (the 'handled by recursion' fallback only saw the `{ kind: "markup", node }` wrapper), so every lifted `label` stayed a bare identifier — a ReferenceError at load.
rationale: §15.10.1: 'Nested logic blocks inside markup inside logic blocks SHALL be walked recursively' and the substitution 'SHALL apply at every ExprNode position reachable from a logic-block body'; 'A `for-stmt` loop variable … shadows props within their respective scopes.'
